source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 19 (PDF 38-58), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 19 (Basics of Organic Chemistry) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The number of carbon containing compounds known today is more than:
(Aaj kal maloom carbon wale compounds ki tadaad kitne se zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hum 20 million se zyada carbon wale compounds jaante hain, jin mein se zyada tar organic chemistry mein parhe jaate hain (19.1).

book_ref.quote: Today, we are familiar with more than 20 million carbon containing compounds

blocks.prompt:
2 According to IUPAC, organic chemistry is the study of compounds containing carbon bonded to itself, hydrogen or other elements:
(IUPAC ke mutabiq organic chemistry un compounds ka mutaala hai jin mein carbon khud se, hydrogen ya doosre elements se juda ho:)

options.text: kuch inorganic compounds ko chhor kar
oxygen wale tamam compounds chhor kar

blocks.explanation: IUPAC ki definition mein kuch inorganic compounds (carbonates, cyanides, CO₂, CO) shamil nahi (19.1).

book_ref.quote: the study of compounds containing carbon, where carbon is bonded to itself, hydrogen, or other elements

blocks.prompt:
3 Which one of the following is excluded from organic chemistry although it contains carbon?
(In mein se kaun sa carbon rakhne ke bawajood organic chemistry se bahar rakha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbonates, cyanides (jaise KCN), CO₂ aur CO riwayati inorganic compounds hain jo organic chemistry se bahar hain (19.1; chhapa hua 'KCl' darust kar ke KCN).

book_ref.quote: which are excluded from organic chemistry are carbonates

blocks.prompt:
4 Organic compounds are generally distinguished from inorganic compounds by their:
(Organic compounds aam tor par inorganic compounds se kis cheez se pehchane jaate hain?)

options.text: zyada melting points aur paani mein zyada solubility
zyada densities aur zyada boiling points
kam melting points, kam densities aur paani mein kam solubility
ionic fitrat aur zyada melting points

blocks.explanation: Organic compounds ke melting aur boiling points kam, densities kam aur paani mein solubility kam hoti hai (19.1).

book_ref.quote: Organic compounds can be easily distinguished from inorganic compounds by their unique properties

blocks.prompt:
5 The ability of self-linkage between atoms of the same element is called:
(Aik hi element ke atoms ke aapas mein judne ki salahiyat ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Catenation (Latin catena = zanjeer) aik hi element ke atoms ka aapas mein judna hai (19.1).

book_ref.quote: The ability of self-linkage between the atoms of the same element is known as catenation

blocks.prompt:
6 Carbon forms long chains and rings through:
(Carbon lambi chains aur rings kis ke zariye banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon mazboot C–C covalent bonds ke zariye lambi chains aur rings banata hai; yahi catenation hai (19.1).

book_ref.quote: Carbon forms long chains and rings through the stable

blocks.prompt:
7 According to the chapter, the number of different arrangements possible with four carbon atoms is:
(Chapter ke mutabiq chaar carbon atoms ki kitni mukhtalif tarteebein mumkin hain?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon ki chaar valency (tetravalent) ki wajah se chaar carbon atoms ki chaar mukhtalif tarteebein hain (19.1).

book_ref.quote: with four carbon atoms, there are four different arrangements

blocks.prompt:
8 The large variety of arrangements of carbon atoms in compounds is mainly due to carbon being:
(Compounds mein carbon atoms ki bohat si tarteebon ki asal wajah carbon ka kya hona hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon ka tetravalent (chaar valency wala) hona us ki bohat si tarteebon ki wajah hai (19.1).

book_ref.quote: Tetravalent nature of carbon enables it to have much more different ways of arrangements

blocks.prompt:
9 Why are organic compounds complex, with large structures and vast diversity?
(Organic compounds pecheeda, bari structures aur bohat mukhtalif kyun hote hain?)

options.text: zyada melting points ki wajah se
carbon ke metal hone ki wajah se

blocks.explanation: Catenation hi batati hai ke organic compounds pecheeda, bari structures wale aur bohat mukhtalif kyun hain (19.1).

book_ref.quote: Catenation explains why organic compounds are complex, having large structures and vast diversity

blocks.text: 19.2 Hydrocarbons (Compounds of Carbon and Hydrogen Only)

blocks.prompt:
10 Compounds containing carbon and hydrogen only are called:
(Sirf carbon aur hydrogen wale compounds ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrocarbons woh compounds hain jin mein sirf carbon aur hydrogen hon (19.2).

book_ref.quote: Compounds containing carbon and hydrogen only in their molecules are called hydrocarbons

blocks.prompt:
11 Hydrocarbons are broadly classified into two types on the basis of their:
(Hydrocarbons ko kis bunyad par do qismon mein baanta jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon skeleton (carbon dhaancha) ki bunyad par hydrocarbons open chain (aliphatic) ya closed chain (cyclic) hain (19.2).

book_ref.quote: On the basis of carbon skeleton, hydrocarbons are broadly classified into two types

blocks.prompt:
12 The word 'aliphatic' comes from the Greek word aleiphatos, which means:
(Lafz 'aliphatic' Greek lafz aleiphatos se hai, jis ka matlab hai:)
blocks.explanation: Aleiphatos ka matlab charbi (fat) hai; fats open chain hote hain, is liye open chain hydrocarbons aliphatic kehlate hain (19.2).

book_ref.quote: aleiphatos is a Greek word meaning fat

blocks.prompt:
13 Alkenes and alkynes are classified as:
(Alkenes aur alkynes ko kis mein shumar kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aliphatic hydrocarbons saturated (alkanes) aur unsaturated (alkenes aur alkynes) mein bante hain (19.2).

book_ref.quote: These can be further subdivided into saturated hydrocarbons (alkanes)

blocks.prompt:
14 Hydrocarbons possessing rings of carbon atoms are called:
(Carbon atoms ke rings wale hydrocarbons ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon atoms ke rings wale hydrocarbons closed chain ya cyclic hydrocarbons hain (19.2).

book_ref.quote: Hydrocarbons possessing rings of carbon atoms are called closed chain or cyclic hydrocarbons

blocks.prompt:
15 Cycloalkanes and cycloalkenes, which are cyclic but behave like aliphatic hydrocarbons, are called:
(Cycloalkanes aur cycloalkenes jo cyclic hain magar aliphatic jaisa bartao karte hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Woh cyclic hydrocarbons jo aliphatic jaisa bartao karein alicyclic hain, jaise cycloalkanes, cycloalkenes (19.2).

book_ref.quote: which behave like aliphatic hydrocarbons, are called alicyclic hydrocarbons

blocks.prompt:
16 Which one of the following is an aromatic hydrocarbon?
(In mein se kaun sa aromatic hydrocarbon hai?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene ring ya us jaisi structure wale cyclic hydrocarbons aromatic hain, jaise benzene, naphthalene, diphenyl methane (19.2).

book_ref.quote: having benzene ring or resembling structures are called aromatic hydrocarbons

blocks.prompt:
17 Open chain hydrocarbons are also called:
(Open chain hydrocarbons ko aur kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Open chain carbon atoms wale hydrocarbons acyclic ya aam tor par aliphatic hydrocarbons kehlate hain (19.2).

book_ref.quote: Hydrocarbons possessing open chain of carbon atoms are called open chain or acyclic hydrocarbons

blocks.prompt:
18 An atom or group of atoms, or a double or triple bond, which determines the characteristic properties of an organic compound is called:
(Woh atom, atoms ka group ya double/triple bond jo organic compound ki khaas properties tay kare, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh functional group ki definition hai (19.3).

book_ref.quote: which determines the characteristic properties of an organic compound is called functional group

blocks.prompt:
19 Methanol and ethanol are liquids while methane and ethane are gases at room temperature because alcohols:
(Methanol aur ethanol liquids jabke methane aur ethane gases hain, kyun ke alcohols:)

options.text: apne –OH group ke zariye hydrogen bonds banate hain

blocks.explanation: Alcohols ka hydroxyl group (–OH) hydrogen bonding kar sakta hai; alkanes mein aisa functional group nahi (19.3).

book_ref.quote: Methanol and ethanol are liquids while methane and ethane are gases

blocks.prompt:
20 The melting and boiling points of alcohols are higher than those of their corresponding:
(Alcohols ke melting aur boiling points apne kin mutabiq compounds se zyada hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alcohols ke m.p aur b.p mutabiq alkanes (methanol bamuqabla methane) se zyada hain, hydrogen bonding ki wajah se (19.3).

book_ref.quote: Methanol and ethanol are liquids while methane and ethane are gases.

blocks.prompt:
21 Glucose and sucrose are soluble in water because they:
(Glucose aur sucrose paani mein kyun hal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chhote alcohols, carboxylic acids, glucose aur sucrose apne polar functional groups ki wajah se paani mein hal hote hain (19.3).

book_ref.quote: are soluble in polar solvents like water due to their polar functional groups

blocks.prompt:
22 The types of organic compounds are dictated by the polarity of the bond and the ______ in their functional groups.
(Organic compounds ki qismein functional group mein bond ki polarity aur ______ se tay hoti hain.)
blocks.explanation: Do factors hain: bond ki polarity aur bond order, yani functional group mein bonds ki tadaad (19.3).

book_ref.quote: Bond order i.e. number of bonds in the functional group

blocks.prompt:
23 Which pair has no functional group?
(Kis jore mein koi functional group nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Alkanes aur cycloalkanes mein koi functional group nahi: na charge, na polarity, na double ya triple bond (19.3).

book_ref.quote: Alkanes and cycloalkanes have no functional group in them

blocks.prompt:
24 The nature of the functional group of an organic compound affects:
(Organic compound ke functional group ki nauiyat kis par asar daalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Physical aur chemical dono properties functional groups ki nauiyat se bohat mutasir hoti hain (19.3).

book_ref.quote: Both physical and chemical properties of organic compounds are highly affected by the nature of functional groups

blocks.prompt:
25 The rules for the systematic nomenclature of organic compounds were formulated by:
(Organic compounds ke systematic naam rakhne ke qawaid kis ne banaye?)
blocks.explanation: IUPAC (International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry) ne systematic naamon ke qawaid banaye (19.4).

book_ref.quote: A set of rules was thus formulated by IUPAC

blocks.prompt:
26 The systematic (IUPAC) name of an organic compound is based on the:
(Organic compound ka systematic (IUPAC) naam kis par mabni hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: IUPAC naam parent hydrocarbon par mabni hai aur root, suffix aur prefix par mushtamil hai (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The systematic or IUPAC name of an organic compound is based on the parent hydrocarbon

blocks.prompt:
27 The stem or root of an IUPAC name gives:
(IUPAC naam ka stem ya root kya batata hai?)

options.text: sab se lambi musalsal carbon chain jis mein functional group wala carbon shamil ho

blocks.explanation: Stem sab se lambi musalsal carbon chain batata hai jis mein functional group wala carbon shamil ho (19.4 i).

book_ref.quote: It gives the longest continuous carbon chain including the carbon bearing the functional group

blocks.prompt:
28 While numbering the parent chain, the lowest possible number is given to the carbon bearing:
(Parent chain ko number dete waqt sab se chhota number kis carbon ko diya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Functional group wale carbon ko sab se chhota mumkin number diya jata hai (19.4 i).

book_ref.quote: Lowest possible number is given to the carbon bearing the functional group

blocks.prompt:
29 If the carbon atoms of the parent chain are joined in a ring, the name starts with:
(Agar parent chain ke carbon atoms ring mein jude hon to naam kis se shuru hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ring mein jude carbon atoms ke liye naam 'cyclo' se shuru hota hai (19.4 i).

book_ref.quote: If the carbon atoms are joined in a ring, the name is started by

blocks.prompt:
30 The primary suffix in an IUPAC name indicates:
(IUPAC naam mein primary suffix kya batata hai?)

options.text: parent chain saturated hai ya unsaturated

blocks.explanation: Primary suffix (stem ya root ka suffix) batata hai ke parent chain saturated hai ya unsaturated (19.4 ii).

book_ref.quote: It indicates whether the parent chain is saturated or unsaturated

blocks.prompt:
31 The secondary suffix (suffix of the key functional group) gives:
(Secondary suffix (key functional group ka suffix) kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Secondary suffix compound ka family naam batata hai (19.4 ii).

book_ref.quote: Secondary suffix, also called suffix of the key functional group

blocks.prompt:
32 In an IUPAC name, the prefix gives:
(IUPAC naam mein prefix kya batata hai?)

options.text: side chain ya substituent ka naam, jis carbon se juda ho us ke number ke saath

blocks.explanation: Prefix side chain (alkyl group) ya substituent (halo, nitro waghera) ka naam us ke carbon ke number ke saath batata hai (19.4 iii).

book_ref.quote: It gives the name of the side chain (alkyl group) or any substituent

blocks.prompt:
33 If there is no prefix, the systematic name consists of:
(Agar prefix na ho to systematic naam kis par mushtamil hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Prefix na ho to systematic naam root aur suffix par mushtamil hota hai (19.4 iii).

book_ref.quote: If prefix is absent, then systematic name will consist of root and suffix

blocks.prompt:
34 In the name 3-methylbut-2-en-1-ol, the part 'en' is the:
(Naam 3-methylbut-2-en-1-ol mein 'en' hissa kya hai?)

options.text: secondary suffix jo alcohol batata hai
prefix jo side chain batata hai
stem jo chaar carbon batata hai
primary suffix jo double bond batata hai

blocks.explanation: 'but' stem (chaar carbon), 'en' primary suffix (unsaturated, C=C), 'ol' secondary suffix (alcohol family) aur '3-methyl' prefix hai (19.4).

book_ref.quote: 4-chlorobutanal and 3-methylbut-2-en-1-ol

blocks.prompt:
35 The stem used in the IUPAC name of a compound whose parent chain has four carbon atoms is:
(Jis compound ki parent chain mein chaar carbon atoms hon us ke IUPAC naam mein kaun sa stem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chaar carbon ka stem 'but' hai, jaise 4-chlorobutanal (19.4; book correction: 'prop' nahi).

book_ref.quote: the stem for four carbons is

blocks.prompt:
36 The IUPAC class name of alkyl halides is:
(Alkyl halides ka IUPAC class naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alkyl halides (CₙH₂ₙ₊₁X) ka IUPAC naam halogenoalkane, ziyada theek monohaloalkane hai (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is halogenoalkane (more precisely monohaloalkane)

blocks.prompt:
37 The correct IUPAC name of CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–CH₂–I is:
(CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–CH₂–I ka darust IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prefixes alphabetical tarteeb mein likhe jaate hain (iodo pehle, methyl baad mein), is liye naam 1-iodo-3-methylbutane hai (19.4, book correction).

book_ref.quote: The substituent prefixes are written in alphabetical order

blocks.prompt:
38 Using the general formula of alkyl halides, CₙH₂ₙ₊₁X, the molecular formula of the alkyl chloride with n = 3 is:
(Alkyl halides ke general formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₁X se n = 3 wale alkyl chloride ka molecular formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: CₙH₂ₙ₊₁X mein n = 3: 2(3) + 1 = 7, is liye C₃H₇Cl (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is halogenoalkane (more precisely monohaloalkane)

blocks.prompt:
39 The IUPAC name of the class of alcohols ends in:
(Alcohols ki class ka IUPAC naam kis par khatam hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alcohols alkanols hain, jaise methanol, propan-1-ol, 2-methylpropan-2-ol (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanol.

blocks.prompt:
40 From the general formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₂O, the molecular formula of an alcohol with four carbon atoms is:
(General formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₂O se chaar carbon wale alcohol ka molecular formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: CₙH₂ₙ₊₂O mein n = 4: 2(4) + 2 = 10, is liye C₄H₁₀O (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanol.

blocks.prompt:
41 The IUPAC name of H–C(=O)–H is:
(H–C(=O)–H ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aldehydes alkanals hain; HCHO methanal hai (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanal.

blocks.prompt:
42 The correct condensed formula of 3-methylbutanal is:
(3-methylbutanal ka darust condensed formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 3-methylbutanal mein chaar carbon ki chain hai, CHO carbon 1 aur CH₃ carbon 3 par: CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–C(=O)–H (19.4).

book_ref.quote: CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–C(=O)–H (3-methylbutanal)

blocks.prompt:
43 The IUPAC name of CH₃–C(=O)–CH₃ is:
(CH₃–C(=O)–CH₃ ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ketones alkanones hain; CH₃COCH₃ propanone hai (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanone

blocks.prompt:
44 Aldehydes and ketones have the same general formula. A ketone and an aldehyde each with three carbon atoms both have the molecular formula:
(Aldehydes aur ketones ka general formula aik hai. Teen carbon wale ketone aur aldehyde dono ka molecular formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono CₙH₂ₙO par chalte hain; n = 3 ke liye C₃H₆O (propanone aur propanal) (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanone

blocks.prompt:
45 The IUPAC name of CH₃–COOH is:
(CH₃–COOH ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carboxylic acids alkanoic acids hain; CH₃COOH ethanoic acid hai (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanoic acid

blocks.prompt:
46 The IUPAC name of CH₃–C(=O)–NH₂ is:
(CH₃–C(=O)–NH₂ ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acid amides alkanamides hain; CH₃CONH₂ ethanamide hai (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanamide

blocks.prompt:
47 The IUPAC name of CH₃–CH₂–C(=O)–Cl is:
(CH₃–CH₂–C(=O)–Cl ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acid halides alkanoyl halides hain; CH₃CH₂COCl mein teen carbon: propanoyl chloride (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanoyl halides

blocks.prompt:
48 The IUPAC name of CH₃–C(=O)–O–CH₂–CH₃ is:
(CH₃–C(=O)–O–CH₂–CH₃ ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Esters alkyl alkanoates hain; oxygen par ethyl hai aur acid wale hisse mein do carbon (ethanoate) (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkyl alkanoate

blocks.prompt:
49 The functional group –C(=O)–O–C(=O)– is present in:
(Functional group –C(=O)–O–C(=O)– kis mein hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: –C(=O)–O–C(=O)– acid anhydride ka group hai, naam alkanoic anhydride, jaise ethanoic anhydride (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanoic anhydride

blocks.prompt:
50 Ethers are named in the IUPAC system as:
(IUPAC system mein ethers ka naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethers (–C–O–C–) alkoxyalkanes hain, jaise methoxymethane, ethoxyethane (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkoxyalkane.

blocks.prompt:
51 The IUPAC name of CH₃–CH₂–O–CH₃ is:
(CH₃–CH₂–O–CH₃ ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chhota group alkoxy aur bara group alkane ke tor par: methoxyethane (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkoxyalkane.

blocks.prompt:
52 The IUPAC name of CH₃–CH(NH₂)–CH₃ is:
(CH₃–CH(NH₂)–CH₃ ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh primary amine (alkanamine) hai jis mein NH₂ teen carbon chain ke carbon 2 par hai: propan-2-amine (19.4).

book_ref.quote: There are three types of amines

blocks.prompt:
53 In a secondary amine such as N-methylpropan-1-amine, the nitrogen atom carries:
(Secondary amine jaise N-methylpropan-1-amine mein nitrogen atom par kitne hydrogen hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Secondary amine mein nitrogen par aik hydrogen hota hai: CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–NH–CH₃ (19.4).

book_ref.quote: CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–NH–CH₃ (N-methylpropan-1-amine)

blocks.prompt:
54 CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–N(CH₃)–CH₃ is a tertiary amine named:
(CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–N(CH₃)–CH₃ tertiary amine hai, is ka naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: N par do aik jaise methyl groups hain, is liye N,N-dialkylalkanamine: N,N-dimethylpropan-1-amine (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name may be (R=R) N,N – Dialkylalkanamine

blocks.prompt:
55 The IUPAC name of CH₃–CN is:
(CH₃–CN ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alkyl cyanides alkanenitriles hain; CN ka carbon bhi gina jata hai, is liye CH₃CN (do carbon) ethanenitrile hai (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanenitrile

blocks.prompt:
56 The correct IUPAC name of CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CN is:
(CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CN ka darust IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Naam 2-methylpropanenitrile hai (19.4).

book_ref.quote: CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CN (2-methylpropanenitrile)

blocks.prompt:
57 The IUPAC name of CH₃–CH(NO₂)–CH₃ is:
(CH₃–CH(NO₂)–CH₃ ka IUPAC naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitroalkanes ka naam nitroalkane; propane ke carbon 2 par NO₂: 2-nitropropane (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is nitroalkane

blocks.prompt:
58 Using the general formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₁NO₂, the molecular formula of the nitroalkane with n = 2 is:
(General formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₁NO₂ se n = 2 wale nitroalkane ka molecular formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: CₙH₂ₙ₊₁NO₂ mein n = 2: 2(2) + 1 = 5, is liye C₂H₅NO₂ (nitroethane) (19.4).

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is nitroalkane

blocks.prompt:
59 Which one of the following is NOT a type of structural formula described in the chapter?
(In mein se kaun sa chapter mein bayan kiya gaya structural formula ki qisam NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Structural formulae displayed, condensed aur skeletal hain; empirical formula sirf sab se saada nisbat batata hai (19.5).

book_ref.quote: There are different types of formulae which are used to represent organic compounds

blocks.prompt:
60 The formula which represents the actual number of atoms of each element in a molecule is the:
(Molecule mein har element ke atoms ki asal tadaad batane wala formula kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molecular formula har element ke atoms ki asal tadaad batata hai, jaise butane C₄H₁₀ (19.5).

book_ref.quote: represents the actual number of atoms of each element present in a molecule

blocks.prompt:
61 Ethanol and methoxymethane both have the molecular formula:
(Ethanol aur methoxymethane dono ka molecular formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethanol aur methoxymethane mukhtalif compounds hain magar molecular formula aik C₂H₆O hai (19.5).

book_ref.quote: ethanol and methoxymethane are represented by same molecular formula

blocks.prompt:
62 Two different compounds can have the same molecular formula because a molecular formula gives no information about:
(Do mukhtalif compounds ka molecular formula aik ho sakta hai kyun ke molecular formula kis ke baare mein nahi batata?)

options.text: atoms ke judne ki tarteeb aur functional group

blocks.explanation: Molecular formula atoms ke judne ki tarteeb aur functional group ki nauiyat nahi batata (19.5).

book_ref.quote: molecular formula gives no information about the sequence in which atoms are linked together

blocks.prompt:
63 The empirical formula of hexane, C₆H₁₄, is:
(Hexane (C₆H₁₄) ka empirical formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Empirical formula sab se chhoti poori nisbat hai: C₆H₁₄ ÷ 2 = C₃H₇ (19.5).

book_ref.quote: represents the smallest whole number ratio of atoms of each element

blocks.prompt:
64 Glucose has the molecular formula C₆H₁₂O₆. Its empirical formula is:
(Glucose ka molecular formula C₆H₁₂O₆ hai. Is ka empirical formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mushtarak factor 6 se taqseem: C₆H₁₂O₆ → CH₂O, wahi jo ethanoic acid ka hai (19.5).

book_ref.quote: empirical formula of butane (C₄H₁₀) is C₂H₅

blocks.prompt:
65 For which compound are the empirical and molecular formulae the same?
(Kis compound ka empirical aur molecular formula aik hi hai?)
blocks.explanation: C₃H₆O₂ (3 : 6 : 2) ka koi mushtarak factor nahi, is liye empirical = molecular; baqi sab chhote hote hain (19.5).

book_ref.quote: The formula which represents the smallest whole number ratio of atoms

blocks.prompt:
66 Which formula shows the number of each kind of atom and also the sequence in which they are joined?
(Kaun sa formula har qisam ke atoms ki tadaad aur un ke judne ki tarteeb dono batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Structural formula atoms ki tadaad aur judne ki tarteeb dono batata hai (19.5).

book_ref.quote: not only shows the number of each kind of atom in the molecule but also the sequence

blocks.prompt:
67 The formula which shows all the bonds between atoms, including the type of bonds and positions of functional groups, is the:
(Woh formula jo atoms ke darmiyan tamam bonds, bonds ki qisam aur functional groups ki jagah dikhaye:)
blocks.explanation: Displayed (graphical) formula structural formula ki sab se mukammal shakal hai (19.5).

book_ref.quote: which shows all the bonds between different atoms including the type of bonds

blocks.prompt:

137 Two stereoisomers which are non-superimposable mirror images of each other are called:
(Do stereoisomers jo aik doosre ki non-superimposable mirror images hon, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Non-superimposable mirror image stereoisomers enantiomers hain ('enantio' = mukhalif) (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: non-superimposable mirror image of each other and are called enantiomers

blocks.prompt:
138 The two enantiomers of a compound rotate plane polarised light:
(Kisi compound ke do enantiomers plane polarised light ko kaise ghumate hain?)

options.text: aik hi simt mein barabar miqdaar se
mukhalif simton mein mukhtalif miqdaar se
mukhalif simton mein barabar miqdaar se

blocks.explanation: Enantiomers PPL ko mukhalif simton mein barabar miqdaar mein ghumate hain (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: they rotate the plane of polarised light in opposite directions, with the same extent

blocks.prompt:
139 A mixture containing 50% dextrorotatory and 50% levorotatory enantiomers is:
(50% dextrorotatory aur 50% levorotatory enantiomers wala mixture kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Enantiomers ka 50 : 50 mixture optically inactive hai aur racemic mixture kehlata hai, symbol (±) (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: When 50% dextrorotatory and 50% levorotatory enantiomers are present

blocks.prompt:
140 Meso tartaric acid is optically inactive because:
(Meso tartaric acid optically inactive kyun hai?)

options.text: molecule ke aik hisse ki rotation doosra hissa andar hi khatam kar deta hai
is mein koi chiral carbon nahi

blocks.explanation: Meso forms mein aik jaise chiral carbons aur plane of symmetry hota hai; dono hisse andar hi aik doosre ki rotation khatam kar dete hain (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: rotation of one half of molecule is internally compensated (cancelled) by the other half

blocks.prompt:
141 A meso isomer must contain:
(Meso isomer mein kya hona zaroori hai?)

options.text: kam az kam do aik jaise chiral carbons aur plane of symmetry

blocks.explanation: Meso forms mein kam az kam do aik jaise chiral carbons aur plane of symmetry hota hai (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: contain at least two similar chiral carbon atoms and also possess a plane of symmetry

blocks.prompt:
142 The maximum number of optical isomers of a compound having three different chiral carbon atoms is:
(Teen mukhtalif chiral carbon atoms wale compound ke zyada se zyada kitne optical isomers hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada se zyada optical isomers = 2ⁿ = 2³ = 8 (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: is given by the formula 2ⁿ, where 'n' is the number of chiral carbon atoms

blocks.prompt:
143 The number of optical isomers is less than 2ⁿ when:
(Optical isomers ki tadaad 2ⁿ se kam kab hoti hai?)

options.text: molecule mein do ya zyada aik jaise chiral carbons hon

blocks.explanation: Do ya zyada aik jaise chiral carbons hon to 2ⁿ ki tadaad kam ho jati hai, jaise tartaric acid mein (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: This number is reduced, however, if there are two or more similar chiral carbon atoms

blocks.prompt:
144 A molecule with only one chiral carbon atom is:
(Sirf aik chiral carbon atom wala molecule:)
blocks.explanation: Aik chiral carbon ho to molecule hamesha asymmetric aur optically active hai; zyada hon to zaroori nahi (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: However, if there are more than one chiral atoms, a molecule may or not be asymmetric

blocks.prompt:
145 Cis-trans isomerism in open chain compounds arises due to:
(Open chain compounds mein cis-trans isomerism kis wajah se hoti hai?)

options.text: single bond ke gird free rotation
double bond ke gird restricted rotation

blocks.explanation: Cis-trans isomers open chain compounds mein double bond ke gird rukawat wali gardish (restricted rotation) se bante hain (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: due to restricted rotation about a double bond in open chain compounds are called cis-trans isomers

blocks.prompt:
146 Forms of butane interconverted by free rotation about the C2–C3 single bond are called:
(Butane ki woh shaklein jo C2–C3 single bond ki free rotation se aik doosre mein badalti hain, kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh conformational isomers hain; free rotation se badalte hain aur room temperature par alag nahi kiye ja sakte (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: are called conformational isomers because they are interconvertable

blocks.prompt:
147 The energy needed to break the π bond for free rotation about the C=C bond, according to the chapter, is:
(Chapter ke mutabiq C=C bond ke gird free rotation ke liye π bond todne ki energy kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: π bond todne ke liye 263 kJ/mol chahiye jo room temperature par nahi milti, is liye rotation ruki rehti hai (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: It requires energy equal to 263 kJ/mol, which is not possible at room temperature

blocks.prompt:
148 The π bond of the C=C double bond in but-2-ene is formed by:
(But-2-ene ke C=C double bond ka π bond kis se banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: σ bond sp² orbitals ke seedhe overlap se; π bond p orbitals ke mutawazi (parallel) overlap se (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: a π bond formed by the parallel overlap of p orbitals

blocks.prompt:
149 In a cis isomer, the two similar groups are:
(Cis isomer mein do aik jaise groups kahan hote hain?)

options.text: double bond ki aik hi taraf

blocks.explanation: Cis: aik jaise groups double bond ki aik hi taraf; trans: mukhalif taraf (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: The cis isomer is one in which two similar groups are on the same side of the double bond

blocks.prompt:
150 Which compound shows cis-trans isomerism?
(Kaun sa compound cis-trans isomerism dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: But-2-ene ke har double bond carbon par do mukhtalif groups (H aur CH₃) hain; baqi mein aik carbon par do aik jaise groups hain (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: two different groups must be attached to each of the doubly bonded carbon atoms

blocks.prompt:
151 2,3-Dimethylbut-2-ene does not show cis-trans isomerism because:
(2,3-dimethylbut-2-ene cis-trans isomerism kyun nahi dikhata?)

options.text: har double bond wale carbon par do aik jaise CH₃ groups hain
is ka double bond aazadi se ghoomta hai

blocks.explanation: Agar unsaturated carbon par do aik jaise groups hon to cis-trans isomerism mumkin nahi (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: cis-trans isomerism will not be possible, if one of the unsaturated carbon atom is bonded to two identical groups

blocks.prompt:
152 Compared with the cis isomer, the corresponding trans isomer is generally:
(Cis isomer ke muqable mein trans isomer aam tor par:)

options.text: tamam physical properties mein aik jaisa

blocks.explanation: Trans isomers cis se zyada mustahkam (stable) hain aur reactivity aur physical properties mein mukhtalif hain (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: The trans isomers are more stable than the corresponding cis isomers

blocks.prompt:
153 Cis and trans isomers of a compound differ in:
(Kisi compound ke cis aur trans isomers kis mein mukhtalif hain?)

options.text: melting point, boiling point aur dipole moment

blocks.explanation: Cis-trans isomers m.p, b.p, dipole moment, density, heat of vapourisation waghera mein mukhtalif hain (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: different physical properties like melting point, boiling point, dipole moment

blocks.prompt:
154 In but-2-ene, carbon atoms 2 and 3 are:
(But-2-ene mein carbon atoms 2 aur 3 kaise hybridized hain?)
blocks.explanation: But-2-ene ke C-2 aur C-3 sp² hybridized hain; π bond molecule ko aik position mein jakar deta hai (19.9.1).

book_ref.quote: The presence of π bond locks the molecule in one position

blocks.prompt:
155 In the synthesis of pharmaceutical products, chirality is critical because it determines:
(Dawaiyon ki tayyari mein chirality aham kyun hai? Yeh kya tay karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chirality dawa ki hifazat (safety) aur asar (efficacy) tay karti hai (19.10).

book_ref.quote: chirality is a critical feature to determine safety and efficacy

blocks.prompt:
156 The two enantiomers of a chiral drug often behave very differently in the body because drug receptors:
(Chiral dawa ke do enantiomers jism mein aksar bohat mukhtalif asar kyun karte hain? Kyun ke drug receptors:)

options.text: bohat khaas chiral locks ki tarah kaam karte hain

blocks.explanation: Biological systems chiral building blocks se bane hain; receptors khaas 'chiral locks' ki tarah kaam karte hain (19.10).

book_ref.quote: the two enantiomers of a chiral drug often exhibit vastly different potentials and profiles

blocks.prompt:
157 Thalidomide was originally distributed as:
(Thalidomide shuru mein kis shakal mein diya gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Thalidomide (tranquilliser) shuru mein racemic mixture ki shakal mein diya gaya (19.10).

book_ref.quote: Thalidomide, a tranquilliser was originally distributed as racemic mixture

blocks.prompt:
158 Research on thalidomide showed that the isomer which damaged the fetus was the:
(Thalidomide par research se pata chala ke kaun sa isomer bachche (fetus) ko nuqsan deta tha?)
blocks.explanation: (+) isomer asar dar aur mehfooz tha; (–) isomer fetus ko nuqsan deta tha (19.10).

book_ref.quote: the (+) isomer was an effective and safe tranquilliser, the (-) isomer was the culprit

blocks.prompt:
159 Giving only the pure (+) isomer of thalidomide would not be safe because:
(Thalidomide ka sirf khalis (+) isomer dena bhi mehfooz kyun nahi?)

options.text: khoon mein jaldi racemise ho jata hai

blocks.explanation: Khalis (+) thalidomide khoon mein jaldi racemise ho jata hai; 10 minute mein 50% se zyada (19.10).

book_ref.quote: racemisation of the pure (+) isomer occurs rapidly as soon as it enters the blood stream

blocks.prompt:
160 After its withdrawal, thalidomide was later:
(Wapas lene ke baad thalidomide ko baad mein:)

options.text: sakht control ke saath dobara market kiya gaya
morning sickness ke liye aazadi se becha gaya

blocks.explanation: Book correction: USA mein 1998 (leprosy ki pechidgi) aur 2006 (multiple myeloma) ke liye sakht control ke saath dobara manzoor hua (19.10).

book_ref.quote: it was approved in the USA in 1998 for a complication of leprosy
